data.action: 跪坐在将臣身后，左手停在他肩头，右手腕被他回伸的右手轻握，侧过脸泛红
data.camera: medium landscape side-view two-shot, both people from head to waist
data.description: 训练后的和风静室内，茉子跪坐在将臣身后的坐垫上，正伸出双手为将臣捏揉酸痛的肩膀。看似平日大大咧咧的护卫，在将臣反手轻握住她纤细手腕道谢时，脸颊瞬间涨得通红。头顶呆毛一颤一颤，猫嘴慌乱地别开视线，语无伦次地自曝心声——「哇啊！突、突然抓手腕什么的太犯规了！在下只是作为护卫尽本分而已啦……！」
data.lighting: 纸拉门外透入的浓郁黄昏暖金光晕与室内柔和阴影
data.location: 和室榻榻米坐席拉门前
data.promptProse: The side view of the tatami room keeps both people in profile. At the left, short dark-haired Masaomi sits in a slate training shirt and turns his face back over one shoulder. Mako kneels on the cushion behind him to the right, her long sidelocks over a frilled white apron. Her left hand rests on his shoulder and he gently catches her right wrist as she blushes.
data.title: 常陆茉子 · 榻榻米上的推拿羞红
data.animaCaption: At the center of the side shot, Masaomi reaches back and loosely catches Mako's right wrist beside his shoulder. He sits on the left with cropped dark hair and a slate shirt, his face turned to her. Behind him on the right, Mako kneels in a white apron, long sidelocks framing her blush as her left hand remains on his shoulder. Evening sun warms the paper doors.
